Linkmenai Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Utena County, Lithuania

Not demolished. Linkmenys was home to fishermen and timber traders — including Jewish wagoners nicknamed 'Di Wozhakes' — and produced Dr. Shemuel-Leib Zer, a scholar of literature and the Hebrew Bible at Yeshiva University in New York. Unusually, after WWI the village itself was divided between Poland and Lithuania, with the new cease-fire line running directly through this cemetery, leaving most of the town's Jews unable to visit their ancestors' graves; after sustained lobbying, both governments eventually agreed to allow visits twice a year, during the Fast of Gedalia and Tisha B'Av.
